perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.

enhanced.name: Ancillary Ordinance
enhanced.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. More missiles can be prepared.

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

enhanced.name: Bewildering Burst
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.

perks.name: Lead From Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power causes your next final blow with this weapon to grant bonus Special ammo meter progress.

enhanced.name: Lead From Light
enhanced.description: Picking up an Orb of Power causes your next final blow with this weapon to grant bonus Special ammo meter progress. Increases the stack count limit.

perks.name: Stopping Power
perks.description: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets.

enhanced.name: Stopping Power
enhanced.description: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets within an improved range.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

enhanced.name: Rewind Rounds
enhanced.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.description: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Lone Wolf
enhanced.description: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Lucky Shot
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves.

enhanced.name: Lucky Shot
enhanced.description: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves for an improved duration.

perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance
perks.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, detonates shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

enhanced.name: Adhesive Ordnance
enhanced.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, has an improved detonation shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

enhanced.name: Kinetic Tremors
enhanced.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets. Perk activates more quickly.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

enhanced.name: Mega Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a longer period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

enhanced.name: All-Star

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch

perks.name: Closing Time

enhanced.name: Closing Time
